story_text:
## The Problem: The Industrial Compromise
For decades, getting professional air pressure meant accepting industrial compromises. You had to sacrifice your desk space for a bulky, heavy metal tank. You had to endure loud, rumbling motors and aggressive vibrations that shook your entire workstation. Worst of all, you were permanently chained to a wall outlet.
Traditional compressors were built for the garage, not the modern creator studio. You shouldn’t have to fight your equipment just to stay in the zone.
## The Solution: The Air Compressor, Evolved
It’s time for your air source to evolve. Meet the TurboX Pro.
We took heavy-duty pneumatic performance, cut the cord, and engineered it into a sleek, modern footprint no bigger than a standard notebook. Housed in a high-strength PC and ABS shell, it balances rugged durability with a beautiful, minimalist design.
This isn't just a shrunken compressor; it is a completely reimagined desktop air center built for absolute freedom. Raw power meets smart digital precision, giving you the performance of a traditional 2-liter tank without the noise, the bulk, or the wires.
## Feature Highlights
## Absolute Freedom
Your inspiration doesn’t stop at the edge of your desk. Armed with a massive 15,600 mAh battery, the TurboX Pro Cordless Edition delivers up to 180mins of intermittent spraying. Paint your scale models on the living room table, pack it into a beauty case for on-the-go makeup, or take it outside to spray under the open sky. No wall outlets. No limits. (Note: A standard corded edition is also available for permanent desk setups).
## Desktop Footprint
Mobility means nothing without power. Inside the TurboX Pro’s compact 180mm frame, a brushless dual-pump system works in perfect harmony with a 200ml stainless steel air tank. This intelligent architecture delivers up to 45 PSI of continuous, pulse-free airflow, pushing heavy primers and high-viscosity metallics just as effortlessly as a traditional heavyweight compressor.
## High-Pressure Output (1–45 PSI)
With adjustable working air pressure from 1 to 45 PSI, the TurboX Pro accommodates a wide range of air-pressure requirements. Use lower settings for precision spraying and low-pressure tasks, or higher settings for suitable air tools, liquid atomization, and inflation.
## Smart Inverter Control
Inside the TurboX Pro, a brushless dual-pump system works in perfect harmony with a 200ml stainless steel air tank and our proprietary Smart Inverter Technology. This intelligent combination allows our compact footprint to rival the performance of a traditional 2-liter tank. It delivers up to 45 PSI of continuous, pulse-free airflow, pushing heavy primers and high-viscosity paints effortlessly.
## One Tool. Infinite Applications.
Going beyond standard airbrushing, the TurboX Pro features 4 built-in operating modes. Switch to Blower Mode for delicate detailing, Ball Mode to inflate sports gear with automatic pressure shut-off, or Custom Mode for specialized pneumatic tools.
## One Smart Compressor for Every Task
Whether you’re laying down paint on a scale model, airbrushing special effects makeup, dusting out a custom PC build, decorating culinary piece, or tackling weekend DIY projects, the TurboX Pro adapts to whatever you’re creating.
## Studio-Silent
Because the Smart Inverter only draws the exact power you need, it eliminates frustrating start-stop cycles, prevents overheating, and drops operational noise to a quiet 43 to 53 decibels.
## Thermal Protection
Built with an active protection and a dual-duct cooling pathway, the compressor continuously dissipates heat from the internal core. It prevents unexpected thermal shut-offs, keeping your machine running safely through long, uninterrupted painting sessions.
## Vibration Dampening
Combining a compact internal layout with high-friction silicone footpads, the TurboX Pro is designed to help reduce vibration and keep the unit stable during operation. Integrated mounting slots on the side accommodate short and long brackets, keeping compatible tools within easy reach and helping you maintain a more organised workspace.
## Digital Moisture Alert
Water in your airline ruins paint jobs. To protect your work, we integrated a world-first digital moisture alert system that tracks condensation and warns you exactly when it’s time to drain. Paired with active thermal protection that alerts at 85°C and auto-shuts off at 95°C, it delivers rock-solid safety for heavy-duty, uninterrupted creation.
## Dual Outlets & Modular Mounts
Constantly swapping hoses kills your focus. The TurboX Pro features a dual air outlet design with modular mounts. Connect two different airbrushes in advance, and seamlessly switch between broad priming and fine detailing without ever breaking your creative rhythm.
## Build Quality & Desktop Design
The TurboX Pro combines a high-strength PC + ABS housing with a stainless steel air tank for a durable, compact desktop design. Measuring 18 × 13 × 14 cm and weighing approximately 1.5 kg for the corded version and 1.8 kg for the cordless version, it integrates the dual-pump system, air tank, and control electronics into a compact unit that leaves more room for your tools and projects.
## Compact Layout & Interface
## Cordless VS Corded
Available in two configurations: a 24V DC plug-in version for fixed workstations, and a 15,600 mAh Li-ion Battery Edition for cordless operation. Under specified test conditions, the battery version delivers up to 180 minutes of intermittent spraying at 15 PSI or can inflate approximately 400 standard basketballs on a full charge.
Pass-through charging also allows the unit to operate while connected to a power source.

risks: Bringing TurboX Pro from development to delivery involves several important steps, including final product validation, manufacturing, quality control, and shipping. As a precision air system with integrated electronics, a dual-pump structure, and Smart Inverter Technology, maintaining consistent performance and product quality across production batches is a key priority. We will conduct quality checks and product testing to help ensure that each unit meets our intended performance and reliability standards. Manufacturing and logistics may also be affected by component availability, production schedules, or shipping delays. We will work closely with our manufacturing and logistics partners to monitor progress, address issues as they arise, and keep backers informed of any significant changes to the delivery timeline. For the battery-powered edition, we will also pay particular attention to battery handling and shipping requirements, which may vary by destination. Our priority is to deliver a product that meets the expectations set by this campaign. If any unexpected challenges affect production or delivery, we will communicate updates transparently and explain the steps being taken to resolve them. Thank you for supporting TurboX Pro and being part of this journey with us.

faq.q: What makes Smart Inverter Technology better than a standard desktop pump?
faq.a: Standard mini pumps run at a single fixed output, which often leads to airflow pulsation, paint splatter, over-heating, and excessive noise. Smart Inverter Technology continuously monitors air demand and adjusts motor RPM in real time. Combined with our dual-pump system and built-in 200 ml stainless steel tank, it delivers steady, pulse-free air pressure (up to 45 PSI) while keeping heat, energy draw, and noise (~53 dB) to a minimum.

faq.q: How does a 200 ml tank deliver stable pressure compared to a large traditional compressor?
faq.a: Traditional compressors rely on massive 3L–6L tanks to hold air because their motors only turn on or off at fixed limits. TurboX Pro uses Smart Inverter control to dynamically regulate air generation inside a high-efficiency 200 ml stainless steel buffer tank. This setup smooths out output fluctuations instantly without taking up valuable workspace.

faq.q: Can I use the Cordless Edition while it is charging?
faq.a: Yes. The Cordless Edition features pass-through charging. You can plug it into a power source and continue working without waiting for the battery to fully recharge.

faq.q: What if the battery in Cordless Edition stops working? Can I replace them?
faq.a:
The battery is not removable and we do not recommend doing that.

If the battery stops working over time, the compressor can still be used normally by plugging it directly into the power adapter.

Additionally, the battery comes with a one-year warranty.
